title: DXF AcDbAssocEdgePersSubentId typed codec
scope: Retain and emit the DXF class-specific AcDbAssocEdgePersSubentId version and index fields, with fail-closed handling for incomplete payloads. This does not implement or qualify the civil DWG body layout.

autodeskApi.observation: Autodesk describes AcDbAssocEdgePersSubentId as identifying edge subentities by two endpoint or arbitrary index identifiers. This establishes the API-level meaning, not DXF/DWG serialization order.

libreDwgSchema.observation: The peer schema models the Edge persistent-subentity class version, index1, index2, and dependent-on-compound flag; it annotates the integer fields with DXF group code 90. This is corroborating schema evidence, not ODA wire authority.

odaSpecification.title: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
odaSpecification.observation: The scanned text contains no class-specific serialized-body layout for AcDbAssocEdgePersSubentId. No DWG parser change is based on this DXF codec result.

implementation.model: DRW_AssociativeObject stores Edge class version and both signed 32-bit indices separately from the AcDbAssocGeomDependency class version.
implementation.dxfRead: The AcDbAssocPersSubentId subclass requires exactly three ordered group-90 values for AcDbAssocEdgePersSubentId, validates class version as a nonnegative uint16 value, and requires the compound flag after the complete tail.
implementation.dxfWrite: The AC1024 associative dependency writer emits Edge class version, index1 and index2 as three ordered group-90 values. It refuses missing Edge fields and refuses Edge-only values attached to AcDbAssocSingleEdgePersSubentId.
implementation.dwgBoundary: The DWG parser and physical civil selector are unchanged; incomplete physical Edge bodies remain refused pending independent body/string-span and handle-role evidence.
implementation.abi: Public DRW_AssociativeObject layout changed. ABI and consumer qualification remain open under P8.

tests.coverage: ASCII/Binary writer field order, required-field refusal, mismatched SingleEdge refusal, ASCII/Binary generated DXF import retention, and ASCII writer output surviving typed dx_iface re-import.

validation.fixtures: Generated controls use scratch output; no DWG/DXF fixture was committed.
